_note: Structured for future ustrip seeding. 'tag' on each item is 'plan' (in the family's ground-truth doc) or 'optional' (candidate idea, not decided).

trip.name: USA Trip 2026
trip.route_summary: NYC → Finger Lakes → Niagara Falls (Canada side) → Lancaster/Amish → Washington DC → Philadelphia → Atlantic City → New Jersey → home

pickup.location: Manhattan West Side, near W 40th St

rental_car.class_needed: Premium SUV, 7-8 seats (Suburban / Yukon XL / Expedition MAX or similar) — sized for 5 adults + 5 suitcases
rental_car.note: One overnight in Canada (Niagara Falls, Ontario) — needs cross-border coverage

items.desc: Land Newark Liberty (EWR), UA85.
Transfer to Manhattan: taxi/Uber ~$100-130, or NJ Transit train to Penn Station ~30-40 min ~$18/person (~$90 for 5).
Check in: Delta Hotels Times Square.
Times Square (7 min walk) → Broadway → Radio City Music Hall → Rockefeller Center → back through Times Square once lit.
Central Perk coffeehouse — 7th Ave & 47th St.
Dinner in Hell's Kitchen.
Sunset sail around Manhattan (Classic Harbor Line / Manhattan by Sail).
Breakfast.
Central Park: Columbus Circle → The Mall → Bethesda Terrace & Fountain → the lake → Bow Bridge → Strawberry Fields.
Down Fifth Avenue: Apple Fifth Avenue, LEGO Store, St. Patrick's Cathedral, Rockefeller Center.
Nintendo New York — same stretch of Fifth Ave.
Top of the Rock observation deck — reserve ahead, ~$42.
Grand Central Terminal — historic hall, painted ceiling.
Broadway musical, Theater District. Same-day rush/lottery tickets exist for most shows (~50% off).

days.title: Downtown & Brooklyn
days.note: Open decision: could swap for Packers @ Jets game (MetLife Stadium, Jets home opener) instead — see nyc-proposals.md.

items.desc: Instead of the day below: Packers @ Jets, MetLife Stadium, Jets' home opener.
Subway to 9/11 Memorial & Museum and the Oculus → Wall Street → Charging Bull.
Mercer Labs — immersive art/tech museum (21 Dey St).
Walk south to Battery Park.
Free Staten Island Ferry (passes Statue of Liberty, ~25 min) or Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island ferry (~$26, book ahead).
NYC Ferry, Battery Park/Pier 11 → DUMBO, Brooklyn (~$4/person). Lunch at Time Out Market. Brooklyn Bridge Park, Manhattan Bridge photo spot.
Walk Brooklyn Bridge back to Manhattan for golden hour/lights (~1.8km, easy grade).
Dinner in Chinatown or SoHo.
Meow Parlour cat café — Lower East Side.
Feast of San Gennaro — Little Italy, runs Sep 17-27.

days.title: Hudson Yards, High Line, West Village

items.desc: Hudson Yards (15 min walk) — the Vessel, riverfront skyscrapers. If Top of the Rock skipped, consider Edge observation deck (~1.5 hrs).
City Climb at Edge — extreme, ~$185/person (verify).
Intrepid Sea, Air & Space Museum — high priority per family list.
B&H Photo — must-do per list; closed Saturdays, today (Monday) works.
Walk the High Line south (~2km) through gardens, art, views.
Chelsea Market, or rooftop food at Pier 57.
Little Island floating park; through Meatpacking District cobblestones.
Whitney Museum — lower priority than MoMA.
Greenwich Village: flagship Harry Potter Store near Flatiron, "Friends" building photo op on Bedford St, Bleecker St, Washington Square Park.
National Museum of Mathematics (MoMath) — Flatiron District.
SoHo — cast-iron architecture, shopping.
MoMA instead of part of this day.
Jazz club — Village Vanguard or Smalls.
Pick up rental car — West Side Manhattan, near W 40th St.
Drive ~4-4.5 hrs / ~400km. Stretch stop (~2 hrs in) around Stroudsburg/Delaware Water Gap or Binghamton.
Watkins Glen State Park — Gorge Trail past 19 waterfalls (1.6 mi, ~2 hrs incl. photos). Hiking shoes; keep parking receipt (valid at other Finger Lakes parks). Shuttle weekends only after Sep 8.
Drive along Seneca Lake, Route 14 (~25 min with scenic stops).
Drive ~2.5 hrs to Niagara Falls.
Niagara Falls State Park (US side) — bring a change of socks/shoes, you will get soaked.
Cave of the Winds — $23/person, includes poncho; buy at park, timed elevator entry.
Maid of the Mist boat to base of falls — $30.25/person, boats every 15 min; buy a few days ahead to skip the line.
Cross Rainbow Bridge to Canadian side, check in.
Niagara Parkway — view of all three falls; Clifton Hill lights/attractions; falls illuminated + fireworks. Bring Canadian dollars.
Drive Niagara → Lancaster County (~6-6.5 hrs); stretch stop after ~3.5 hrs.
Leonard Harrison State Park — overlook of Pine Creek Gorge ("PA Grand Canyon"). Skip steep Turkey Path; short flat overlook walk. Free entry/parking.
Lunch in Wellsboro — 19th-century small-town feel, gaslit Main Street. Timeless Destination (Italian/American) or Harland's Family Style Restaurant.
Drive to Lancaster, arrive ~18:30.

The Amish Farm and House bus + farm tour — classic ~$28.95/person (~2-3 hrs), premium incl. 1805 farmhouse ~$36.95/person (~3-4 hrs). Arrive 30 min early; some vendors cash-only. Tours depart 11:00/13:00/15:00.
Considered and dropped: Amish Experience VIP Tour (private, up to 14 people, ~3.5 hrs, ~$100 more/family) — only runs at 17:00.
Drive between farms/villages of Birds in Hand, Intercourse, Ronks, Strasburg — horse-drawn buggies alongside the road.
Shopping at Tanger Outlets Lancaster.
Drive Lancaster → Washington DC (~120 mi, 2.5-3 hrs).
Check in; dinner in Georgetown; evening walk past illuminated monuments.

days.title: Washington DC & museums
days.note: Not driving a private car around the National Mall on a Saturday — parking scarce/expensive; leave car at hotel, use Metro or taxis.

items.desc: Capitol Hill.
National Museum of Natural History (~2 hrs) — no advance booking, security-line order; arrive early.
Lunch.
National Air and Space Museum (~2.25 hrs) — 5 tickets already reserved.
View of the White House; family photo. National Mall: Washington Monument → WWII Memorial → Reflecting Pool → Vietnam & Korean War Memorials → finish at illuminated Lincoln Memorial.
Free entry to Smithsonian museums — reserve free timed ticket in advance where required.
International Spy Museum (paid).
Drive DC → Philadelphia (~2.5-3 hrs).
Liberty Bell, Independence Hall, Congress Hall / President's House (Independence National Historical Park).
Reading Terminal Market.
Franklin Court, Elfreth's Alley, Old City.
The "Rocky Steps" at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.
Drive to Atlantic City (~1.5 hrs) → check in, boardwalk, casino.
Beach, pool, shopping at Tanger Outlets Atlantic City (no sales tax on clothes/shoes in NJ).
A show.
Drive to New Jersey (~2-2.5 hrs).
The Mills at Jersey Gardens — huge indoor outlet mall near Newark.
American Dream — indoor water park, ice skating, Nickelodeon Universe rollercoasters.
Six Flags Great Adventure — rollercoasters.
Woodbury Common Premium Outlets.
Optional quick trip into Manhattan (20-30 min by train/bus).
Target / Kohl's in Secaucus; evening at Harmon Meadow complex.
Laundry; pick up melatonin.
Arrive Newark Airport Rental Car Center (Waze: "Newark Airport Rental Car Center" / Station P3). Fuel up 5-10km before airport — airport/agency refueling pricier.
Return car at Terminal A Parking Garage, then AirTrain (or shuttle) to Terminal A if departing from B/C.
Depart EWR, UA84.
Land Tel Aviv (TLV), Fri Oct 2.
